text: Reserve Bank of India retains repo rate at 6.5 percent in latest monetary policy review — third consecutive hold
Income Tax Department extends assessment year return filing deadline to July thirty-first for individual assessees
Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation announces twenty percent water supply cut in western suburbs due to pipeline repair work
Ministry of Consumer Affairs issues mandatory quality standards for domestic pressure cookers sold across retail stores
Unique Identification Authority of India mandates free online document update on Aadhaar portal until September fourteenth
Securities and Exchange Board of India simplifies nominee addition process for mutual fund folio holders
Food Safety and Standards Authority of India directs dairy cooperatives to display complete nutritional labelling on packaged paneer
Supreme Court of India directs all high courts to dispose of pending cheque bounce cases within six months
Ministry of Railways announces special Vande Bharat sleeper train services connecting Bengaluru and Ernakulam from next month
Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs notifies new e-invoice generation threshold of five crores for GST taxpayers
Telecom Regulatory Authority of India implements strict rules against unsolicited commercial communication on cellular networks
Ministry of Environment Forest and Climate Change bans single-use plastic carry bags below one hundred and twenty microns
Directorate General of Civil Aviation issues advisory to airlines regarding mandatory compensation for delayed domestic flights
Indian Meteorological Department issues red alert for heavy rainfall in coastal districts of Karnataka and Kerala
Reserve Bank of India permits linking of Rupee credit cards to unified payments interface for foreign nationals visiting India
Ministry of Education launches National Curriculum Framework guidelines for foundational stage learning in primary schools
Karnataka Transport Department makes high-security registration plates compulsory for all vehicles registered prior to April 2019
Indian Computer Emergency Response Team issues high-severity warning for popular web browsers urging immediate security updates
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare issues revised guidelines for international arrivals amid rising sub-variant cases abroad
Ministry of Power notifies revised green energy open access rules to promote renewable power consumption in industries
